anchoredLines.line: 🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 2 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Nora Frost. From Thornfield." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Rafael. Big Loud, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.
